about: Translation teams the Hub's localisation page links to (ticket #40, PRD HUB-08): public teams on Pontoon, Weblate or Crowdin that translate open-source software into Arabic or Tamazight and accept new translators. Each team has a name, its platform (pontoon, weblate or crowdin), what is translated there in English and Arabic (Markdown), and one link per language: ar (Arabic), kab (Kabyle, in Latin script) or zgh (Tamazight in Tifinagh, the standard used in Morocco). checked: the day the list was last reviewed. site/tools/links.py opens every link, and the Link check workflow runs it every week.

teams.name: Mozilla
teams.en: Firefox on computers and phones, Thunderbird and Common Voice, Mozilla’s open speech dataset.
teams.ar: Firefox على الحاسوب والهاتف، وThunderbird، وCommon Voice، مجموعة البيانات الصوتية المفتوحة من Mozilla.

teams.name: Hosted Weblate
teams.en: Many free software projects in one place, among them F‑Droid, NewPipe, Tor and the Debian installer.
teams.ar: مشاريع حرة كثيرة في مكان واحد، منها F‑Droid وNewPipe وTor ومثبّت Debian.

teams.name: LibreOffice
teams.en: The office suite: Writer, Calc, Impress and their help pages.
teams.ar: حزمة المكتب: Writer وCalc وImpress وصفحات المساعدة الخاصة بها.

teams.name: Fedora
